probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Ingrid Solberg © Work Courses Products Journal About Overview [email protected] Contact Menu Close 01 Work 02 Courses 03 Products 04 Journal 05 About 06 Overview 07 Contact [email protected] (About) I design brands people can keep using Brand and art director in Oslo. Independent since 2019, working with studios, makers and cultural spaces across the Nordics. (Story) I started in a Stockholm agency drawing logos for launches that were forgotten a season later. The work that lasted was always the work with the fewest, clearest decisions. Four years in Copenhagen taught me to build systems instead of pieces: type, colour, photography and tone that a team can carry without me in the room. Since 2019 I run a one-person studio in Oslo. I take a few projects a year, and I record what I learn from them as courses and templates for designers starting out. Years in identity 12 Brands delivered 140+ Students taught 3,200 Countries, one studio 4 (Experience) 2019 to now Independent brand and art director Oslo 2015 to 2019 Senior designer, branding studio Copenhagen 2012 to 2015 Designer, advertising agency Stockholm 2009 to 2012 BA in visual communication Bergen (Services) 01
